notes-dir.label: Notes folder
notes-dir.desc: Folder scanned for Markdown notes and todos. Created if it does not exist.

inbox-file.label: Inbox file
inbox-file.desc: File inside the notes folder that quick captures are appended to.

poll-interval-ms.label: Rescan interval
poll-interval-ms.desc: How often the folder is checked for changes, in milliseconds.

scan-depth.label: Subfolder depth
scan-depth.desc: How many levels of subfolders to scan for .md files.

ai-backend.label: AI provider
ai-backend.desc: Where AI features send requests. OpenCode Go uses your subscription; the CLI runs the opencode agent; the rest use their own API.

ai-model.label: AI model
ai-model.desc: Model id for the selected provider. OpenCode Go defaults to deepseek-v4-flash; set the provider's own model otherwise, e.g. gpt-4o-mini, claude-sonnet-4-5, gemini-2.0-flash, llama3.2.

ai-base-url.label: API base URL
ai-base-url.desc: Override the provider API base URL. Leave empty for the provider default. Required for a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:1234/v1.

api-key.label: API key
api-key.desc: Optional. Stored in plain text in Noctalia's settings file, so prefer an environment variable or a key file where you can.

api-key-env.label: API key environment variable
api-key-env.desc: Name of an environment variable to read the key from, e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY. Checked before the provider's own defaults.

ai-max-tokens.label: Max reply tokens
ai-max-tokens.desc: Maximum tokens per reply. 0 uses the provider's default, which is recommended: reasoning models can otherwise spend the whole budget thinking and return nothing.

ai-capture.label: AI capture
ai-capture.desc: Let the model turn a captured sentence into a todo or a note with tags and a due date.

max-context-notes.label: Notes in AI context
max-context-notes.desc: How many notes are sent along with a question.

daily-dir.label: Daily notes folder
daily-dir.desc: Subfolder where the Today button creates YYYY-MM-DD notes.

archive-file.label: Archive file
archive-file.desc: Completed todos are moved here by Clear done. Hidden from the index.

due-reminders.label: Due reminders
due-reminders.desc: Notify once when a todo becomes due or overdue.

git-history.label: Git history
git-history.desc: Commit the notes folder after changes. Off by default; enabling it runs git init if the folder is not already a repository.

git-debounce-ms.label: Commit delay
git-debounce-ms.desc: How long to wait after the last change before committing, in milliseconds.

desktop-items.label: Desktop tile items
desktop-items.desc: How many open todos the desktop widget shows.

show-label.label: Show count
show-label.desc: Show the number of open todos next to the icon.

hide-when-empty.label: Hide when empty
hide-when-empty.desc: Hide the widget when there are no open todos and no notes.

icon-color.label: Icon color
icon-color.desc: Icon color; defaults to the theme's primary. Turns red when something is overdue.
